title: Section 20 CPC — Residence or cause of action

content.overview: Section 20 CPC is the residual territorial rule: sue where the defendant resides, carries on business or works for gain, or where the cause of action arises wholly or in part.
content.study: Do not start with Section 20 if Sections 16 to 19 already fix the forum. For a contract or money claim, identify residence or business of the defendant and the facts that form the cause of action. A sliver of the cause of action is enough if it is a real part, not a manufactured one. Corporations have a special explanation for principal office and subordinate office.
